title: Headphones, Exploded View
prompt: An exploded technical view of over-ear headphones: headband, sliders, ear cups, drivers and cushions separate along their axes, hold, and reassemble in a seamless loop on a white background.
description: How to model a product at real size from lathe, torus and swept-section recipes and drive a staggered, loop-safe exploded view from one easing curve in a high-key white studio.

brief.prompt: An exploded technical view of over-ear headphones: headband, sliders, ear cups, drivers and cushions separate along their axes, hold, and reassemble in a seamless loop on a white background.

techniques: kit.lathe profiles stretched into oval cups and drivers
swept rounded-rectangle section built with kit.mesh and bmesh normals
staggered explode offsets keyed with kit.animate from one easing curve
dashed technical axis lines scaled with the explosion
lit cyclorama sweep with backdrop area light
fine procedural bump for bead-blasted matte plastic
